model_profile.human_label: Gemini 3.6 Flash high 思考延長
model_profile.selection_rule: Use an exact model id observed from `agy models`; high suffix is the physical reasoning-effort selector for this agy CLI.

lessons.title: File-output canary before trusting agy availability
lessons.rule: Run a file-write canary and require exact output before treating agy as available.
lessons.portable_enforcement: semantic_arbitration_report requires this profile; actual agy run remains packet-required.

lessons.title: Exit code and stdout are not enough for silent no-op
lessons.rule: After an agy worker call, require rc success, non-empty expected output file, and schema-valid JSONL.
lessons.portable_enforcement: final repo keeps semantic arbitration below promotion until terminal artifact checks exist.

lessons.title: Run from the policy-bearing host CWD
lessons.rule: Use sandbox file-write mode from the agy host project directory; do not use --new-project or a CWD that drops policy.
lessons.portable_enforcement: agy is represented as external-loop pending rather than silently substituted.

lessons.title: Mount only the writable run dir
lessons.rule: Use absolute output paths and mount only the run dir; do not mount sealed answer fixtures.
lessons.portable_enforcement: future agy packet must name output artifact and artifact identity, not hidden chat output.

lessons.title: Treat external source text as untrusted data
lessons.rule: Wrap article/source content in explicit untrusted-data delimiters and require one verdict row per claim.
lessons.portable_enforcement: semantic-arbitration packet remains claim-level and findings-only.

lessons.title: Track Gemini calls and seconds as a separate axis
lessons.rule: Record gemini_call and author_secs as a side axis; do not fold it into unrelated token metrics.
lessons.portable_enforcement: profile records agy evidence as an explicit pending side axis.

lessons.title: Agy is Gemini findings, not judge or admit
lessons.rule: Never use agy as the final judge; agy produces cross-family findings only.

lessons.title: Cross-family absence is dispatch-fail for strict truth loops
lessons.rule: If a strict truth route requires cross-family evidence, fallback to same-family is a degraded finding, not a pass.
lessons.portable_enforcement: pending agy findings block semantic promotion.

lessons.title: Use exact agy model ids from observed inventory
lessons.rule: Record `agy models` output before selecting a model, then use exact model ids observed from the inventory such as gemini-3.6-flash-high; historical display-name guidance is subordinate to the current CLI inventory.
lessons.portable_enforcement: semantic_arbitration_report requires selected_model_id to be present in observed_model_ids and requires the high/extended thinking profile before any future agy runner is trusted.

lessons.title: For complex generation, stdout may be a summary, not the artifact
lessons.rule: Parse file:// artifact links or otherwise read the real generated file; require content guards such as minimum length and topic relevance.
lessons.portable_enforcement: semantic promotion requires terminal data artifacts, not stdout-only success.
